concept: IAM: role via instance profile instead of access keys on EC2
tests: Knowing the secure way to give an EC2 application access to S3 without long-lived credentials.
expected: An IAM role attached via an instance profile, with a read policy scoped to one bucket. Temporary credentials from IMDS rotate automatically. Triggers: "EC2 must read S3" + "MOST secure".
why_not: Keys in env vars or baked into the AMI are long-lived secrets that leak and are rotated manually; a public bucket exposes data to everyone, and a security group is a network layer that does not control S3 access.
